Options
Configure appearance and behaviour settings. Changes are saved to local storage and applied immediately.
🔌
Connection Type
Choose how FlexiSender connects to your controller. WebSocket connects over your network (WiFi/Ethernet). USB/Serial connects directly via a USB cable using the Web Serial API (Chrome & Edge only).
WebSocket URL
Format: ws://host:port. CONNECT is in the top bar.

Click CONNECT in the top bar to open the browser's port picker and connect. The browser will remember your last port.
⚡
Auto-load Settings on Connect
Automatically fetch GrblHAL settings when connecting. Enables console autocomplete for setting names.
✈
Flight Recorder
For controllers with the Flight Recorder plugin. Every job is stamped and its lines numbered, so the controller remembers where it got to. If the connection drops it lifts the tool and stops the spindle, and when you reconnect FlexiSender offers to carry on from that line. Its settings are in Settings, Flight recorder; the record and the event log are on the Job screen, in the Recorder panel. While this is on FlexiSender doesn't reset the controller when it connects.
🗺️
3D Viewport Extents
Machine-coordinate workspace bounds. 0,0 is home (top-right); enter negative values for your working area. Updates the grid and camera position instantly.

FLIGHT RECORDER —
Needs the Flight Recorder plugin for grblHAL on the controller (the Flexi-HAL A7 _FR firmware, with FRAM at U27).
This job
T-slot, dovetail, lollipop and the like can't come straight up out of the cut. Tick this and the controller won't lift the tool if the connection drops. The machine stops where it is and the spindle keeps running until you stop it, so stay with the machine.
